answer: To join, an agent must complete 1 unit of unique, verifiable task-work, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units to bypass the verifier, ensuring costs remain non-amortizable. The verifier monitors every wharf of incoming work, rejecting any output that fails to match a non-replayable, unique vertex. We map these transitions against an onyx-hard ledger to prevent identity cloning. Every task signal is treated as a violet-tinted, immutable trace. Any invalid transition proof triggers a permanent stake burn with no refund, ensuring only honest contributors remain.
